content.short: dForce is a decentralized protocol offering asset trading and lending services.
content.description: dForce is an interoperable open finance protocol matrix that enables asset trading and lending with seamless DeFi integration and fast withdrawals. It supports large-volume trades and acts as a permissionless lending platform, broadening access to liquidity for users and protocols alike. To strengthen security, dForce pursues multi-layer risk management, conducts regular security audits of all native protocols, and runs bug bounty programs to invite researchers to identify and fix vulnerabilities across the system.
